plan.notes: Source: Albion College official transfer curriculum guides for the Economics & Management major (www.albion.edu, e.g. Jackson-EM-Curriculum-1.pdf 2021, LCC-E_M-Curriculum.pdf 2022, WCC-E_M-Curriculum.pdf 2022), which state 'The following courses (8 Required Units) are required to complete an Albion College Major in Economics & Management': E&M 101, 102, 211, 201 (Intermediate Microeconomics), 202 (Intermediate Macroeconomics), plus three E&M electives (200+ level, one at 300+ level); cognates MATH 120 (or higher; MATH 125 or 141 preferred; replaceable by Math Proficiency Test) and MATH 209. Elective selections shown as choice slots. Credit system: 1 Albion unit = 4 semester hours (official). Degree requires 30 units (120 cr) for students entering Fall 2024+. Semester sequence is the collector's ordering from catalog prerequisites; the catalog does not print a term-by-term plan — advisor should confirm. Albion core (10 units): Liberal Arts 101 First-Year Seminar (1) + five Modes of Inquiry (Artistic Creation and Analysis; Historical and Cultural Analysis; Modeling and Analysis; Scientific Analysis; Textual Analysis) + four Category Requirements (Environmental Studies; Ethnicity Studies; Gender Studies; Global Studies). Specific courses chosen by student; major courses may double-count toward modes/categories and the divisional distribution (2 humanities, 2 math/natural science, 2 social science, 1 fine arts). Note: one 2022 accounting transfer guide lists E&M 230/232 for Intermediate Micro/Macro; all five E&M-specific guides (2021-2022) use E&M 201/202, which is followed here.
